full_judgment: 3. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that P.W. 1 stated that after filing the suit the defendants forcibly constructed the road in the last part of Baishak, the plaintiffs in their application dated 26.7.89praying for local inspection admitted that on 12.5.89, which is two and a half months before the institution of the suit, the road was constructed; admittedly the road in question is an old one and it is there construction of the public road to connect villages through the khas land and during the pendency of the suit there was no construction of new road and so the decision as arrived at by the High Court Division cannot be sustained in law.
